Could you tell me which 30-minute slots you have free that week? For reference, John's open windows in his 09:00–17:00 day are:
- Mon Nov 23: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Nov 25: 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30, 15:00–15:30

If you'd rather pick from your own calendar, just send me a couple of times and I'll check them against his.
